properties.description: DNS listener transport started by the Fabric DNS server.

properties.description: Network host on which the Fabric DNS server listens.

properties.description: Network port on which the Fabric DNS server listens.

properties.description: Whether the Fabric DNS server raw response cache is enabled.

properties.description: Maximum raw DNS responses retained by the Fabric DNS server cache.

properties.name: bus.fabric.dns.cache-ttl
properties.description: Raw DNS response cache time to live.

properties.name: bus.fabric.dns.cache-serve-stale-ttl
properties.description: Window during which expired DNS cache entries may be served after refresh failure.

properties.name: bus.fabric.dns.cache-prefetch-before-expiry
properties.description: Window before DNS cache expiry that triggers background prefetch on active hits.

properties.name: bus.fabric.dns.max-udp-payload-bytes
properties.description: Maximum UDP DNS response payload size.

properties.name: bus.fabric.dns.rate-limit-per-second
properties.description: Maximum DNS queries allowed per client per second, or zero to disable rate limiting.
